newsitem.title: USA: Clinton Mexico trip schedule undecided.
newsitem.headline: Clinton Mexico trip schedule undecided.

text.p: The White House on Sunday left open the possibility that President Bill Clinton, who is recovering from an injured knee, would not visit Mexico next month as scheduled.
"The president has not made a final decision" on whether to go ahead with the trip as scheduled on April 11-12, an official, who asked not to be identified, said.
"The president is definitely going to be visiting Mexico this spring. We are looking at several different configurations," the official said.

Another Clinton trip -- to Costa Rica, Brazil, Argentina and Venezuela -- is still planned for May, the official said. He declined to speculate whether the Mexican visit might be added to the second, multi-country trip or whether either trip would be abbreviated.
The Mexican state news agency Notimex, citing an unnamed White House official, reported on Saturday that Clinton had postponed his trip to Mexico until the second week of May.
Clinton tore a tendon in his right knee when he stumbled on some steps at the Florida home of Australian golfer Greg Norman last Friday.
